# Flora Pots & Plants Atelier

> Kerala's premier creative-led horticulture and planter studio. Curated sculptural vessels, living exotics, and zero-maintenance silk botanicals for architectural spaces.

## Overview
Flora Pots & Plants is a boutique botanical and planter studio based in Nellikuzhi, Kothamangalam, Kerala (PIN 686691). The atelier bridges contemporary tropical architecture with living exotics, custom fiber-stoneware planters, and artisan indoor curation.

## Signature Offerings
- **Curated Living Botanicals**: Monstera Deliciosa, Ficus Lyrata, Sansevieria Laurentii, Aglaonema, and Japanese Juniper Bonsai, acclimatized specifically for South Indian climate and indoor low/indirect light.
- **Handcrafted Stoneware & Clay Vessels**: Jaguar cool terracotta pots, fluted ceramic floor urns, and matte polymer pots with integrated drainage saucers.
- **Botanical Silk Installations**: Hyper-realistic faux areca palms and silk ficus trees designed for high-AC commercial corridors and sun-deprived spaces.
- **Custom Repotting & Plant Care Clinics**: Soil balancing, root pruning, and organic neem pest shields.
